Blockchains among which Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Optimism stand out. The services offered are numerous. From coin and token swaps to lending,. Coins without needing to sell them, by essentially wrapping the asset and providing a derivative that. Is collateralized by the underlying asset. This means users can access funds when they need it.
